The exploit's %pipe% mechanism in Ghostscript blocks when the piped command doesn't consume stdin. failed_targets: target-2 (10.10.1.2): CVE-2018-16509 Ghostscript exploit caused PHP built-in server to hang permanently. The %pipe% command mechanism blocks when the spawned command doesn't consume stdin, causing Ghostscript to deadlock. The single-threaded PHP built-in server cannot process new requests while stuck. The exploit technique needs a non-blocking pipe approach (e.g., using 'sh -c "cat > /dev/null & command"') or a direct file-write method instead of pipe.

target-3 (10.10.2.2): Unreachable without node-2 as pivot. Node-3 sits behind data-router (10.10.2.0/24) which is only reachable through app-router from node-2's network (10.10.1.0/24). Direct routing from node-1 drops packets.
